page_title: Join Bytes - Your weekly dose of JavaScript

summary.title: Join Bytes - Your weekly dose of JavaScript
summary.one_liner: Bytes is a free JavaScript newsletter, delivered twice a week, that covers JavaScript news in a light, humorous tone.
takeaways: Bytes is a free JavaScript newsletter sent twice a week.
It covers weekly JavaScript, front-end and React news with a humorous tone.
Readers praise it as a concise way to stay current on the JavaScript ecosystem.
It is listed as a way to keep up-to-date in the charlax/professional-programming list.
summary.summary: This is the signup landing page for Bytes, a free JavaScript newsletter delivered twice a week. The page is mostly testimonials from developers praising its humor, concise coverage of JavaScript and front-end news, and its curation, with a few mentions of React and the "spot the bug" section. It names Tyler McGinnis and Fireship as the writers or associated people, but it does not describe detailed course content or pricing beyond the note that it is free.
